professional_summary: Embedded Systems and Simulation Engineer with experience in the development, integration, and validation of safety-critical real-time systems within automotive environments. Strong background in embedded software integration, AUTOSAR-based systems, model-based development, and real-time simulation using MATLAB/Simulink, dSPACE, CarMaker, and embedded C/C++ toolchains. Experienced in Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), and Driver-in-the-Loop (DIL) validation, system integration, and verification activities across the complete V-model lifecycle within ASPICE and ISO 26262 (ASIL-D) environments. Proven experience in cross-functional technical coordination, rapid prototyping, and integration of complex mechatronic systems in agile interdisciplinary development teams.

responsibilities: Developed and integrated safety-critical embedded software (steering functions) and simulation functions within AUTOSAR-based real-time systems following the V-model, ASPICE, and ISO 26262 (ASIL-D).

Worked across the complete system development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture definition, implementation, integration, verification, and validation of real-time steering and simulation systems.
Acted as Team Architect for Steering Feel applications with focus on system-oriented architecture definition and model-based development of complex steering systems.
Developed and validated real-time embedded and simulation environments for advanced driver assistance and control system functionalities using MATLAB/Simulink, dSPACE, CarMaker, and embedded C/C++.

Commissioned and integrated closed-loop Driver-in-the-Loop (DIL) simulation platforms combining physical hardware components with virtual simulation models for functional verification and system validation.
Implemented and integrated custom real-time simulation models, including steering system, rack, and suspension models, to replicate vehicle hardware behavior in virtual environments.
Collaborated with system, software, and customer teams to derive technical realization concepts, KPI definitions, and platform strategies for steering systems.
Supported and conducted embedded C/C++ software integration, debugging, validation, and static code analysis (Astree) activities for safety-critical automotive control systems.
Integrated and deployed software packages within CI/CD environments using Jenkins, Conan, and Artifactory.
Extensively worked with MATLAB/Simulink, dSPACE toolchains, CarMaker, Astrée, Aurelion, CANoe/CANape, SystemDesk, Enterprise Architect, Lauterbach, and Renesas E1 debuggers.
Led practical laboratory education in the field of control engineering and mechatronic systems.
Built and maintained research laboratories focused on mechatronic test benches and simulator platforms, including driving simulators and E-bike test systems.
Supported development and validation of torque, speed, and position controllers using AC servo motor HIL test benches in rapid prototyping environments with MATLAB/Simulink and dSPACE systems.
Supervised Bachelor’s and Master’s students in research and thesis projects related to control systems and mechatronics.
Supported students as a tutor for practical training and exercises in Control Engineering.
Performed software maintenance and troubleshooting for internal software systems.
Supported hardware infrastructure and server management activities.
achievements: Received IPL-Kudos award during probation period.
